### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer building scalable platform services and shared libraries for Oportun, a mission-driven financial services company. Improving reliability, developer productivity, delivery velocity, and engineering quality.
Senior Software Engineer building platform services for Oportun's mission-driven financial services business
- Tech stack: AWS, Azure, Cloud, Distributed Systems, Google Cloud Platform, Java, C++

- Identify and address performance, scalability, and reliability issues across platform services
- Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions

- 3+ years designing, building, deploying, and maintaining container-based applications
- 4+ years working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer building scalable platform services and shared libraries for Oportun, a mission-driven financial services company. Improving reliability, developer productivity, delivery velocity, and engineering quality.
Senior Software Engineer building platform services for Oportun's mission-driven financial services business
Role description:
• Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain scalable, reliable platform services and shared libraries
• Contribute to platform and system architecture decisions focused on reliability, scalability, and developer experience
• Write high-quality, maintainable code and model strong engineering practices
• Collaborate with Staff Engineers and peers to implement standards and patterns supporting Continuous Delivery
• Identify and address performance, scalability, and reliability issues across platform services
• Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions
• Improve monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices
• Investigate production root causes and implement long-term fixes to reduce on-call burden
• Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance
• Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business and customer value
• Proactively propose improvements
• Use AI tools thoughtfully to reduce manual work and make better decisions faster
Role requirements:
• 7-8 years of related software engineering experience with a bachelor's degree, or a master's degree with an equivalent combination of education and experience
• Strong experience in software development focused on backend systems and services
• Proficiency in Java, C#, C++, or similar backend languages
• Strong knowledge of software design principles, data structures, and algorithms
• Experience building and operating scalable, reliable, and secure systems
• 3+ years designing, building, deploying, and maintaining container-based applications
• 4+ years working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
• Experience with Continuous Delivery practices and automated deployment pipelines
• Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
• Effective communication and collaboration skills
• Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to team-level technical leadership
• Working knowledge of secure development practices and security considerations in distributed systems
• Open to experimenting with AI tools and willing to learn
Benefits:
• 401(k) Company Match
• Medical Insurance
• Dental Insurance
• Vision Insurance
• Life Insurance
• Disability Insurance
• Flexible PTO
• Competitive compensation and benefits package supporting physical, financial, and professional well-being
Tech stack:
AWS, Azure, Cloud, Distributed Systems, Google Cloud Platform, Java, C++
